summary: Preserve mailbox custody and cursor paging through agent renames

replay.detail: No claim or projection changes; existing immutable identity and alias indexes are reused.

rules.detail: Mailbox custody and recipient lifecycle authorization compare immutable identities, including retirement successors; unrelated actors remain denied.

compatibility.detail: Old and new agent names select the same mailbox and may be interchanged when paging with newly issued cursors. Cursors issued before this change with alias spellings must be restarted.

downtime.detail: Only the normal binary restart is required.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration; restart mailbox pagination after rollback.
